questions.question: The solution for [latex]\int_{0}^{\pi /6}\cos^{4} 3\theta \sin^{3}6\theta d\theta[/latex] is:
questions.explanation: [latex]\begin{aligned} &\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi }{6}}\cos ^{4}3\theta \sin ^{3}6\theta d\theta \\    &=8\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi }{6}}\cos ^{6}3\theta \sin ^{3}3\theta \cos 3\theta \, d\theta\\ \text{Put } \sin 3\theta &=t \\ \Rightarrow \; 3\cos 3\theta \, d\theta &=dt \\ \Rightarrow \;   I&=\frac{8}{3}\int_{0}^{1}\left ( 1-t^{2} \right )^{3}\: t^{3}.\: dt \\    &=\frac{8}{3}\int_{0}^{1}\left ( t^{6}-2t^{2}+3t^{4} \right )t^{3}\: dt \\    &=\frac{8}{3}\int_{0}^{1}\left ( t^{3}-t^{9}-3t^{5}+3t^{7} \right )\: dt \\    &=\frac{8}{3}\left [ \frac{t^{4}}{4}-\frac{t^{10}}{10}-\frac{3t^{6}}{6}+\frac{3t^{8}}{8} \right ]_{0}^{1} \\    &=\frac{8}{3}\left [ \frac{1}{4}-\frac{1}{10}-\frac{3}{6}+\frac{3}{8} \right ] \\    &=\frac{8}{3}\left [ \frac{30-12-60+45}{120} \right ] \\    &=\left [ \frac{1}{15} \right ] \end{aligned}[/latex]
